overview: Two ways to express a compound's composition — one shows the simplest whole-number ratio, the other shows the actual count of atoms.
genZNote: Empirical formula is the simplified recipe. Molecular formula is the actual full order.

aspects.label: Definition
aspects.valueA: Simplest whole-number ratio of atoms of each element in a compound.
aspects.valueB: Actual number of atoms of each element in one molecule of the compound.

aspects.label: Relationship
aspects.valueA: Can be the same as or a simplified version of the molecular formula.
aspects.valueB: Always a whole-number multiple (n) of the empirical formula.
